$sources: NBCC 2020 4.1.3.2 and Table 4.1.3.2-A (load combinations for ultimate limit states: principal and companion loads)
source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.3.2-A: 1.4D; 1.25D + 1.5L with 1.0S or 0.4W; 1.25D + 1.5S with 1.0L or 0.4W; 1.25D + 1.4W with 0.5L or 0.5S; 1.0D + 1.0E with 0.5L + 0.25S; 0.9D where the dead load counteracts. The roof's snow or roof live load is the case Lr (the snow table puts the larger in it) with S as its alternate. H at 1.5. The allowable stress combinations stay the parent's (ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4), for the materials the parent designs by allowable stresses (NDS timber, TMS masonry): NBCC itself has none.

loadCases.Lr: Roof live load or snow (the larger)

strength.name: 1.25D + 1.4W + 0.5L
strength.note: companion L at 0.5; storage, equipment and service areas take 1.0 (not formed: raise the factor under Code Values for them)

strength.name: 0.9D + 1.4W
strength.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.3.2-A, case 4 with 0.9D where the dead load counteracts (4.1.3.2(5))

strength.name: 1.0D + 1.0E + 0.5L + 0.25S
strength.note: companion L at 0.5; storage, equipment and service areas take 1.0 (not formed)

strength.name: 1.0D + 1.0E
strength.source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.3.2-A, case 5 without the companion loads (4.1.3.2(3): a companion load not acting)

service.name: D + L
service.source: NBCC 2020 4.1.3.5: deflection under the specified loads (1.0D + 1.0L)
service.note: L taken with the roof load Lr at 1.0

service.name: D + 0.5L
service.source: Sustained loads for creep and long-term deflection (SAEngine practice; NBCC 4.1.3.5 leaves the sustained share to the material standard)

service.name: D + 0.5L + 0.75W
service.source: NBCC 2020 4.1.3.5 and Table 4.1.7.3: lateral deflection under wind with the SLS importance factor IW 0.75 (on W of IW 1.0)
service.note: 0.75W of the normal importance category: SAEngine practice

overstrength: NBCC 2020 4.1.8 and the material standards' capacity design (CSA A23.3-19 Clause 21, CSA S16-19 Clause 27): the elements the yielding system loads take its probable resistance or the elastic forces with Rd Ro = 1.3; SAEngine's Em = Ω0 E uses Ω0 = Ro of the system (SAEngine practice)

sources.strength: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.3.2-A cases 1-5 with their companion loads and 4.1.3.2(5) (0.9D counteracting)
sources.service: NBCC 2020 4.1.3.4 to 4.1.3.6 (SAEngine practice for the sustained share and the service wind)
sources.temperature: NBCC 2020 4.1.3.2(4): T with the factor 1.25 (SAEngine reading: with the principal 1.5L)
sources.pDeltaPreload: NBCC 2020 case 5: the gravity loads of the earthquake combination, 1.0D + 0.5L
sources.allowable: ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4 (the parent's), for the parent's allowable stress materials only
